Surah headingp. 509

Sura al-Shuara

‌ ‌سُورَةُ الشُّعَرَاءِ

Report 01p. 509Q 26:7

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "of every noble kind" [al-Shuara 7] meaning: "of the plants of the earth, of what people and livestock eat."

أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيمٍ} [الشعراء: 7] ، يَعْنِي: «مِنْ نَبَاتِ الْأَرْضِ مِمَّا يَأْكُلُ النَّاسُ وَالْأَنْعَامُ»

Report 02p. 509Q 26:14

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "and they have against me a [claim of] sin" [al-Shuara 14] he said: "for the killing of the person he killed from among them."

أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {وَلَهُمْ عَلَيَّ ذَنْبٌ} [الشعراء: 14] قَالَ: «مِنْ قَتْلِ النَّفْسَ الَّتِي قَتَلَ مِنْهُمْ»

Report 03p. 509Q 26:19

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "and you did your deed which you did" [al-Shuara 19] meaning: "by it, the killing of the person."

أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ الَّتِي فَعَلْتَ} [الشعراء: 19] ، يَعْنِي: «بِهِ قَتْلَ النَّفْسِ»

Report 04p. 509Q 26:20

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "and I was of those astray" [al-Shuara 20] he said: "meaning of the ignorant."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {وَأَنَا مِنَ الضَّالِّينَ} [الشعراء: 20] قَالَ: «يَعْنِي مِنَ الْجَاهِلِينَ»

Report 05p. 509

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Hamza related to us, from Uthman ibn Ata, from his father, who said: "They were six hundred thousand, none among them older than sixty or younger than twenty, and they perished in the wilderness except two men: Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Yufanna."

أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا حَمْزَةُ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: «كَانُوا سِتَّمِائَةِ أَلْفٍ لَيْسَ فِيهِمْ أَكْبَرُ مِنِ ابْنِ السِّتِّينَ، وَلَا أَصْغَرُ مِنْ عِشْرِينَ، فَهَلَكُوا فِي التِّيهِ إِلَّا رَجُلَيْنِ يُوشَعَ بْنَ نُونٍ، وَكَالِبَ بْنَ يُوفَنَا»

Report 06p. 510Q 26:22

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "that you have enslaved the Children of Israel" [al-Shuara 22] meaning: "you subdued them, enslaved them, and put them to work."

أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {عَلَيَّ أَنْ عَبَّدْتَ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ} [الشعراء: 22] ، يَعْنِي: «قَهَرْتَهُمْ، وَاسْتَعْبَدْتَهُمْ، وَاسْتَعْمَلْتَهُمْ»

Report 07p. 510

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Fadl related to us, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Rufay, from Khaythama, from Kab al-Ahbar, who said: "The magicians were seventeen thousand; they began the morning as disbelievers and ended the evening as martyrs."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ رُفَيْعٍ، عَنْ خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ كَعْبِ الْأَحْبَارِ، قَالَ: «كَانَتِ السَّحَرَةُ سَبْعَةَ عَشَرَ أَلْفًا أَصْبَحُوا كُفَّارًا وَأَمْسَوْا شُهَدَاءَ»

Report 08p. 510

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Israil related to us, from Abu Ishaq al-Hamdani, from Abu Ubayda, from Ibn Masud, who said: "The people of Joseph [sic] left Egypt, six hundred and seventy thousand of them, and Pharaoh said: 'Indeed, those are but a small band.'"

أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ الْهَمَذَانِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ: " خَرَجَ أَهْلُ يُوسُفَ مِنْ مِصْرَ وَهُمْ سِتُّمِائَةِ أَلْفٍ وَسَبْعُونَ أَلْفًا، فَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ: إِنَّ هَؤُلَاءِ لَشِرْذِمَةٌ قَلِيلُونَ "

Report 09p. 510

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, who said: "They were six hundred thousand, and the number of Pharaoh's followers could not be counted."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ: «كَانُوا سِتَّمِائَةِ أَلْفٍ، وَكَانَ لَا يُحْصَى عَدَدُ أَصْحَابِ فِرْعَوْنَ»

Report 10p. 510Q 26:56

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Israil related to us, from Abu Ishaq al-Hamdani, from al-Aswad ibn Yazid: that he read it "hadhirun" [al-Shuara 56]. He said: "He says: prepared and equipped."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ الْهَمَذَانِيِّ، عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ: أَنَّهُ قَرَأَهَا {حَاذِرُونَ} [الشعراء: 56] قَالَ: يَقُولُ: «وَادُّونَ مُسْتَعِدُّونَ»

Report 11p. 510Q 26:60

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "and they pursued them at sunrise" [al-Shuara 60] he said: "The companions of Moses left by night, and the moon was eclipsed that night and the earth was dark. The companions of Moses said: 'Joseph ﷺ told us that we would be saved from Pharaoh, and took a covenant from us that we would take his bones out with us.' ⦗p. 511⦘ So Moses went out that night asking about his grave, and found an old woman whose house was over the grave of Joseph. He asked her about it, and she told him on condition of her own judgment, and her judgment was that she said: 'Carry me and take me out with you.' So Moses put the bones of Joseph in his cloak, then put the old woman on his cloak, carried her on his neck, and went out with it. He said: Pharaoh's horses were in full rein in their sight, yet were held back from Moses and his companions until they were out of sight."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {فَأَتْبَعُوهُمْ مُشْرِقِينَ} [الشعراء: 60] قَالَ: " خَرَجَ أَصْحَابُ مُوسَى لَيْلًا وَكَسَفَ الْقَمَرُ تِلْكَ اللَّيْلَةَ، وَأَظْلَمَتِ الْأَرْضُ، فَقَالَ أَصْحَابُ مُوسَى: إِنَّ يُوسُفَ صلى الله عليه وسلم، أَخْبَرَنَا أَنَّنَا سَنُنَجَّى مِنْ فِرْعَوْنَ، وَأَخَذَ عَلَيْنَا الْعَهْدَ لَنَخْرُجُنَّ بِعِظَامِهِ مَعَنَا، ⦗ص: 511⦘ فَخَرَجَ مُوسَى مِنْ لَيْلَتِهِ يَسْأَلُ عَنْ قَبْرِهِ، فَوَجَدَ عَجُوزًا بَيْتُهَا عَلَى قَبْرِ يُوسُفَ، فَسَأَلَهَا عَنْهُ، فَأَخْبَرَتْهُ عَلَى حُكْمِهَا، فَكَانَ حُكْمُهَا أَنْ قَالَتَ: احْمِلْنِي وَأَخْرِجْنِي مَعَكَ، فَجَعَلَ مُوسَى عِظَامَ يُوسُفَ فِي كِسَائِهِ، ثُمَّ حَمَلَ الْعَجُوزَ عَلَى كِسَائِهِ، وَحَمَلَهُ عَلَى رَقَبَتِهِ، وَخَرَجَ بِهِ، قَالَ: وَخَيْلُ فِرْعَوْنَ فِي مَلْءِ أَعِنَّتِهَا حُضْرًا فِي أَعْيُنِهِمْ، وَلَا تَبْرَحُ حُبِسَتْ عَنْ مُوسَى وَأَصْحَابِهِ حَتَّى تَوَارَوْا "

Report 12p. 511Q 26:82

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "and who I aspire will forgive me my fault on the Day of Recompense" [al-Shuara 82] he said: "It is his words 'I am sick,' and his words 'Rather, the biggest of them did this,' and his words to Sarah: 'She is my sister,' when one of the pharaohs wanted to take her."

أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {وَالَّذِي أَطْمَعُ أَنْ يَغْفِرَ لِي خَطِيئَتِي يَوْمَ الدِّينِ} [الشعراء: 82] قَالَ: " هُوَ قَوْلُهُ إِنِّي سَقِيمٌ، وَقَوْلُهُ فَعَلَهُ كَبِيرُهُمْ هَذَا، وَقَوْلُهُ لِسَارَةَ: إِنَّهَا أُخْتِي حِينَ أَرَادَ فِرْعَوْنُ مِنَ الْفَرَاعِنَةِ أَنْ يَأْخُذَهَا "

Report 13p. 511Q 26:119

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, ⦗p. 512⦘ on His words: "in the laden ship" [al-Shuara 119] he said: "The laden ship: one finished and filled."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، ⦗ص: 512⦘ فِي قَوْلِهِ: {فِي الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُونِ} [الشعراء: 119] قَالَ: " الْفُلْكُ الْمَشْحُونُ: الْمَفْرُوغُ مِنْهُ مَمْلُوءًا "

Report 14p. 512Q 26:128

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "on every elevation [riy]" [al-Shuara 128] he said: "on every mountain pass."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ} [الشعراء: 128] قَالَ: «بِكُلِّ فَجٍّ»

Report 15p. 512Q 26:121

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "a sign" [al-Shuara 128] meaning: "a building."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ فِي قَوْلِهِ: {آيَةً} [الشعراء: 121] ، يَعْنِي: «بُنْيَانًا»

Report 16p. 512Q 26:129

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "and take for yourselves fortresses" [al-Shuara 129] meaning: "lofty palaces, strongholds, and houses built to last."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ} [الشعراء: 129] ، يَعْنِي: «قُصُورًا مُشَيَّدَةً، وَحُصُونًا، وَبُيُوتًا مُخَلَّدَةً»

Report 17p. 512Q 26:137

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "This is not but the character [khuluq] of the former peoples" [al-Shuara 137] meaning: "the lie of the former peoples."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا خُلُقُ الْأَوَّلِينَ} [الشعراء: 137] ، يَعْنِي: «كَذِبَ الْأَوَّلِينَ»

Report 18p. 512Q 26:148

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "their spathes are soft [hadim]" [al-Shuara 148] He says: "they crumble to pieces."

أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {طَلْعُهَا هَضِيمٌ} [الشعراء: 148] ، يَقُولُ: «يَتَهَشَّمُ تَهَشُّمًا»

Report 19p. 513Q 26:153

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "You are only of the bewitched [musahharin]" [al-Shuara 153] meaning: "of the enchanted, that is, you have been bewitched."

أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ مِنَ الْمُسَحَّرِينَ} [الشعراء: 153] ، يَعْنِي: «مِنَ الْمَسْحُورِينَ أَيْ سُحِرْتَ»

Report 20p. 513Q 26:154Q 26:156

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Israil related to us, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Rufay, from Abu al-Tufayl, who said: "Thamud said to the Prophet of God Salih: 'Bring a sign, if you are of the truthful' [al-Shuara 154]. Salih said to them: 'Go out.' He took them out to a hill of the land, and it was convulsing as a pregnant woman convulses, then it split open and the she-camel came out from the middle of it. Salih said to them: 'This is a she-camel; she has a [right of] drink, and you have a [right of] drink on a known day. And do not touch her with harm, lest there seize you the punishment of a terrible day' [al-Shuara 156]." He said: "When they grew weary of her, they hamstrung her." Abd al-Aziz ibn Rufay said: A man related to me, saying: "Salih said to them: 'The sign of the punishment is that tomorrow you will wake up green, the second day yellow, and the third day black.'"

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ رُفَيْعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الطُّفَيْلِ، قَالَ: " قَالَتْ ثَمُودُ لِنَبِيِّ اللَّهِ صَالِحٍ {فَأْتِ بِآيَةٍ إِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ} [الشعراء: 154] فَقَالَ لَهُمْ صَالِحٌ: اخْرُجُوا فَخَرَجَ بِهِمْ إِلَى هَضْبَةٍ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ، فَإِذَا هِيَ تَمْخَضُ كَمَا تَمْخَضُ الْحَامِلُ، فَانْفَرَجَتْ فَخَرَجَتِ النَّاقَةُ مِنْ وَسَطَهَا، فَقَالَ لَهُمْ صَالِحٌ: {هَذِهِ نَاقَةٌ لَهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَعْلُومٍ وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ} [الشعراء: 156] قَالَ: فَلَمَّا مَلُّوهَا عَقَرُوهَا، قَالَ عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ رُفَيْعٍ، فَحَدَّثَنِي رَجُلٌ قَالَ: فَقَالَ صَالِحٌ لَهُمْ: آيَةُ الْعَذَابِ أَنْ يُصْبِحُوا غَدًا خُضْرًا، وَالْيَوْمَ الثَّانِي صُفْرًا، وَالْيَوْمَ الثَّالِثَ سُودًا "

Report 21p. 513Q 26:166

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "and leave what your Lord has created for you of your wives" [al-Shuara 166] He says: "you have left the front passages of women for the rear passages of men and the rear passages of women."

أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، ثنا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِكُمْ} [الشعراء: 166] يَقُولُ: «تَرَكْتُمْ أَقْبَالَ النِّسَاءِ إِلَى أَدْبَارِ الرِّجَالِ، وَأَدْبَارِ النِّسَاءِ»

Report 22p. 513Q 26:184

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "and the former creation [jibilla]" [al-Shuara 184] he said: "meaning the former creation."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {وَالْجِبِلَّةَ الْأَوَّلِينَ} [الشعراء: 184] قَالَ: «يَعْنِي الْخَلِيقَةَ الْأَوَّلِينَ»

Report 23p. 513Q 26:189

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "the punishment of the Day of the Shadow" [al-Shuara 189] he said: "meaning the shadow of the punishment that came upon them."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {عَذَابُ يَوْمِ الظُّلَّةِ} [الشعراء: 189] قَالَ: «يَعْنِي ظِلَّ الْعَذَابِ الَّذِي أَتَاهُمْ»

Report 24p. 514Q 26:197

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid: "that the scholars of the Children of Israel know it" [al-Shuara 197]: meaning Abd God ibn Salam and others of their scholars who became Muslim.

أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ: {أَنْ يَعْلَمَهُ عُلَمَاءُ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ} [الشعراء: 197] : يَعْنِي عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ سَلَامٍ وَغَيْرَهُ مِنْ عُلَمَائِهِمْ مَنْ أَسْلَمَ مِنْهُمْ "

Report 25p. 514Q 26:200

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Hammad ibn Salama related to us, from Humayd al-Tawil, who said: I read the Qur'an to al-Hasan and he explained it in affirmative terms [rather than as a denial of divine causation], and I stopped him at His words: "Thus We have inserted it into the hearts of the criminals" [al-Shuara 200]. He said: "It is polytheism; God inserted it into their hearts."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ الطَّوِيلِ، قَالَ: قَرَأْتُ عَلَى الْحَسَنِ الْقُرْآنَ فَفَسَّرَهُ عَلَى الْإِثْبَاتِ فَوَقَفْتُهُ عَلَى قَوْلِهِ: {كَذَلِكَ سَلَكْنَاهُ فِي قُلُوبِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ} [الشعراء: 200] ، قَالَ: «الشِّرْكُ سَلَكَهُ اللَّهُ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ»

Report 26p. 514Q 26:219

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "and your movement among those who prostrate" [al-Shuara 219] meaning: "among those who pray; it used to be said that he saw those behind him in prayer."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِي السَّاجِدِينَ} [الشعراء: 219] ، يَعْنِي: «فِي الْمُصَلِّينَ، وَكَانَ يُقَالُ يَرَى مَنْ خَلْفَهُ فِي الصَّلَاةِ»

Report 27p. 514Q 26:222

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "every sinful liar [affak]" [al-Shuara 222], he said: "meaning a liar among the people."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {أَفَّاكٍ} [الشعراء: 222] ، قَالَ: «يَعْنِي كَذَّابًا مِنَ النَّاسِ»

Report 28p. 514Q 26:223

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "they pass on what is heard" [al-Shuara 223] He says: "Satan: whatever he hears, he passes on to every affak, that is, liar."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {يُلْقُونَ السَّمْعَ} [الشعراء: 223] يَقُولُ: «الشَّيْطَانُ مَا سَمِعَهُ أَلْقَاهُ عَلَى كُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ، أَيْ كَذَّابٍ»

Report 29p. 515Q 26:224

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "And the poets, [only] the deviators follow them" [al-Shuara 224] he said: "The deviators are the devils."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {وَالشُّعَرَاءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ الْغَاوُونَ} [الشعراء: 224] قَالَ: " الْغَاوُونَ: هُمُ الشَّيَاطِينُ "

Report 30p. 515Q 26:225

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words: "Do you not see that in every valley they roam?" [al-Shuara 225] he said: "in every art they are led astray."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ: {أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِي كُلِّ وَادٍ يَهِيمُونَ} [الشعراء: 225] قَالَ: «فِي كُلِّ فَنٍّ يُفْتَنُونَ»

Report 31p. 515Q 26:227

Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid: "and defend themselves after they were wronged" [al-Shuara 227] meaning: "Ibn Rawaha and his companions."

أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ: {وَانْتَصَرُوا مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا} [الشعراء: 227] ، يَعْنِي: «ابْنَ رَوَاحَةَ وَأَصْحَابَهُ»
